name: manticorephp/compiler
description: Manticore — a PHP-to-native AOT compiler, written in PHP and self-hosted; compiles a large PHP 8.5 subset to standalone arm64/x86_64 binaries via LLVM.

scripts-descriptions.build: Install Manticore into $MANTICORE_HOME (default ~/.manticore): the published binary for this platform, else a source build from the pinned release. The compiler needs no php.
